description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShop" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop">
  <bpmn:message id="msgLoginRequest" name="Login request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgLoginResult" name="Login result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgOrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgOrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgPaymentData" name="Payment data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgPaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="msgAddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_OnlineShop" name="Ordering in an Online Shop">
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_System" name="E-Shop System" processRef="Process_System"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Part_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginRequest" name="Login request" messageRef="msgLoginRequest" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginRequest" targetRef="StartEvent_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginResult" name="Login result" messageRef="msgLoginResult" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginResult" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted" messageRef="msgOrderSubmitted" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderFinished" name="Order finished" messageRef="msgOrderFinished" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderFinished" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentData" name="Payment data" messageRef="msgPaymentData" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="Part_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation" messageRef="msgPaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Part_Bank" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Address and payment completed" messageRef="msgAddressPaymentCompleted" sourceRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentCompleted" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ShoppingStart" name="Start shopping"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterLogin" name="Enter login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginRequest" name="Send login request" messageRef="msgLoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_LoginConfirmation" name="Wait for login confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginConfirmation" messageRef="msgLoginResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?" default="Flow_C06"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_ProductMerge" name="Products to select"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_AllSelected" name="All products selected?" default="Flow_C12"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order" messageRef="msgOrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_OrderFinished" name="Wait for order completion">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderFinished" messageRef="msgOrderFinished"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustSplit" name="Payment and address split"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPayment" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPayment" name="Send payment data" messageRef="msgPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation" name="Wait for payment confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmation" messageRef="msgPaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterShipping" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillingDiffers" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?" default="Flow_C23"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterBilling" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_BillMerge" name="Billing address handled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_CustJoin" name="Payment and address join"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Send address and payment completed" messageRef="msgAddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Customer part completed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ShoppingStart" targetRef="Task_EnterLogin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="Task_EnterLogin" targetRef="SendTask_LoginRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginRequest" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_LoginConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_LoginConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" name="Failed" sourceRef="Gw_LoginCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Gw_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="Task_SelectProduct" targetRef="Task_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="Task_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="Gw_AllSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_AllSelected" targetRef="Gw_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_OrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_OrderFinished" targetRef="Gw_CustSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Gw_CustSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="Task_EnterPayment" targetRef="SendTask_SendPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPayment" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_PaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="Gw_CustSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Task_EnterShipping" targetRef="Gw_BillingDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiffers" targetRef="Task_EnterBilling">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" sourceRef="Task_EnterBilling" targetRef="Gw_BillMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" name="No" sourceRef="Gw_BillingDiffers" targetRef="Gw_BillMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Gw_BillMerge" targetRef="Gw_CustJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Gw_CustJoin" targetRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="SendTask_AddressPaymentCompleted" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_System" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoginRequest" name="Login request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginRequest" messageRef="msgLoginRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckCredentials" name="Check login credentials"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginResult" name="Send login result" messageRef="msgLoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoginSent" name="Login result sent"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="msgOrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderFinished" name="Send order finished" messageRef="msgOrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysSplit" name="Payment and shipment split"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gw_SysJoin" name="Payment and shipment join"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_AddressPaymentCompleted" name="Wait for address and payment completion">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AddressPaymentCompleted" messageRef="msgAddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteOrder" name="Complete order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoginRequest" targetRef="Task_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="Task_CheckCredentials" targetRef="SendTask_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S03" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginResult" targetRef="EndEvent_LoginSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S04" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="Task_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="Task_FinishOrder" targetRef="SendTask_OrderFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderFinished" targetRef="Gw_SysSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="Gw_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="Gw_SysSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Task_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gw_SysJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="Gw_SysJoin" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_AddressPaymentCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_AddressPaymentCompleted" targetRef="Task_CompleteOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Task_CompleteOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
